newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated unit to build Hawaii plant.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated unit to build Hawaii plant.

text.p: Hawaii has awarded a subsidiary of Consolidated Natural Gas Co a $35- million contract to build a 26-megawatt power plant, the company said Monday.
The U.S. state gave CNG Energy Services Corp a 25-year, power purchase contract for the plant with Kauai Electric, an electric utility that is a division of Citizens Utilities Co, it said.
CNG Energy is to build the plant on Kauai island and carry out the project as Kauai Power Partners LP, it said.
The plant will be fueled by naphtha, a clean oil refinery by-product that is plentiful in Hawaii, it added.
CNG Energy Services Corporation is the energy marketing subsidiary of Consolidated Natural Gas Company, a producer and distributor of natural gas.
